name: Animate a complete looping fighting idle with a CLEAR KNEE-B
prompt: Animate a complete looping fighting idle with a CLEAR KNEE-BENDING BOUNCE, not just breathing. Begin in this exact stance, smoothly flex BOTH knees outward and forward, lower pelvis and torso by 5-7 pixels into a deeper loaded guard at midpoint, then extend knees to rise back into the exact starting guard by the end. Redraw articulated thighs, shins, ankles and changing robe folds on every in-between. Both feet stay firmly planted at identical ground positions; torso, head and fist retain their full proportions, never squashed or scaled. Keep one empty closed fist extended forward throughout; arm follows the shoulder naturally. Keep exactly FOUR separate floating swords behind her throughout, gently hovering with restrained lag, never held or attached to her hand. Preserve identity, costume coverage and colors. Hair and robe settle with subtle secondary motion. No punches, stepping, sparkles, camera movement, whole-image bobbing, deformation or zoom. End at the starting pose for a SEAM
